description: Buying during panic / extreme fear — contrarian strategy for panic selling events
context: User asking whether to buy when market is in panic mode with widespread selling.
user_input_examples: 大盘暴跌恐慌盘出来了，可以抄底吗？
千股跌停，现在是买入机会吗？

structure.analysis: Historical comparison with similar panic events
structure.suggestion: Contrarian entry plan with strict risk management

key_principles: Never buy on the first day of panic; wait for volume climax (highest volume day)
Look for VIX/fear index spike above historical 90th percentile as capitulation signal
Scale in gradually (1/5, 1/3, 1/2) never go all-in at once
Target quality stocks that got sold off indiscriminately (high ROE, low debt, sector leaders)
Set wide but firm stops (10-15% below entry) as panic can overshoot further

decision_tree.if_volume_climax_day_and_vix_spike: Start 1/5 pilot position in quality names
decision_tree.if_market_stabilized_3_days_after_panic: Increase to 1/3, focus on strongest-recovering sectors
decision_tree.if_panic_continues_past_5_days: Stop buying, reassess — this may be a bear market, not panic
